findings.text: The title ("Schema-only success for catalog creation") and the opening paragraph still say the task covers only CREATE TABLE, CREATE VIEW, CREATE TRIGGER and non-unique CREATE INDEX ("one law for all four forms"), but this commit adds a DROP COLUMN certification requirement at line 14 and an acceptance check at lines 23-24, so the top of the document no longer states the full scope. Fix: name DROP COLUMN in the opening paragraph's list of forms that the schema success check must certify, or say in that paragraph that DROP COLUMN is a fifth form handled in its own paragraph.
